messages:
Liam: Heads up — SolarGrid's DAU dropped from ~4.2k to ~1.5k this week after last week's rollout. Also noticed procurement lead swapped (Ben -> Celeste) and they're starting a 2‑week pilot with EmberAI on Monday. Putting this on renewal watch, need triage and a quick mitigation plan. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/dash/solargrid?range=7d :eyes:

Priya: Saw the same in logs. Top routes affected: /api/generate and /batch/embed. Token units spiked then calls dropped off. Suspect a config flip in last deploy. Pulling logs + metrics now.

Alex: FYI Celeste took over procurement Tuesday. I asked for a short brief — she asked for ROI numbers and an affordable dev-friendly option. EmberAI pilot is definitely on their shortlist.

Jordan: Can we offer a short, time-limited play to stem churn? Proposal: 30d Dedicated trial or burst credits + a 20‑min ROI walkthrough with Celeste. Maya — can you do a compact demo? :calendar:

Maya: I can. Also found something in their app config — prefix cache was disabled in the last deploy, which would explain both latency and cost changes. Snippet I saw:
```
cache.prefix.enabled=false
```
Re-enabling should recover ~30–45% of calls and reduce token churn.

Priya: Nice catch. I'll open an infra PR to re-enable prefix caching and prepare a rollback if needed. If rollback isn't allowed, we can enable at the app layer temporarily.

Alex: I'll push to lock in a 30‑min call with Celeste tomorrow 9:30am PT. Need a slide with (a) monthly cost delta pre/post, (b) quality comparison vs EmberAI on 3 canonical prompts, (c) suggested short-term pricing.

Jordan: I'll draft the slide deck. Need three data slices: seat-level activity, top prompt templates usage, and last-14-day churn cohort. @Rosa can you export those?

Rosa: Exporting now — will drop CSV in #customer-data in ~30m.

CS-bot: Renewal risk flag: HIGH for SolarGrid. Contract size: $42k MRR. SLA: 500 seats. Escalate to Legal only if pricing/legal changes are requested.

Liam: Action plan for EOD tomorrow: 1) Config rollback or app-layer cache re-enable (Priya) 2) Data export (Rosa) 3) Slide + ROI walk (Jordan + Maya) 4) Sales outreach + pricing option (Alex). I'll update the renewal play doc and create calendar invite once Alex confirms availability.

Maya: Suggest adding a short-term burst credit offer (20% for 30d) to blunt EmberAI demo while we show ROI.

Alex: OK to offer 20% burst credits contingent on scheduling the call and enabling cache fix.

Jordan: Great — I'll include that in the invite and list owners. Assigning owners: - Config rollback: Priya - Data export: Rosa - Sales outreach & pricing: Alex - Customer call & slides: Jordan + Maya
Will check back in 24h for updates. :thumbsup:
